spanish: Y dijo Faraón: ¿Quién es Jehová, que oiga su voz para enviar a Israel? No he conocido a Jehová, y a Israel tampoco enviaré.

findings.issue: Supplied copula es is unmarked; מי יהוה is verbless and a copula is allowed only when marked (*es*)
אֶשְׁמַע is 1cs; oiga can be 1cs or 3s and does not explicitly mark the speaker as subject

notes: Otherwise number, participants, names, and piel send force match the packet.
